scope: Static actor only; no LSTM/CNN transition or optimization in this analysis.
LEFT t8 is the post-eighth-LEFT-input, post-first-choice-input recurrent state; no duplicated input.
Physical archive ends at cue/prefix reference: reuse only position and last-travel direction; use recorded choice heading, reference clock plus eight, and exactly zero post-brake motors.
Native action_progress rejects goal/wall/end events; physical-bank failure leaves the run incomplete and preserves the full planned cohort/progress record.
Eight shared headings per prefix are matched by all actual prefix action labels and angles, not row parity.
Explicit original-family aliases are resolved only within the same physical family and LEFT regime, and remain in the full denominator.
Checkpoint, preparation, own-prefix replay, paired summary/raw artifacts and unchanged original actor bytes are bound before readout.
All 1536 neural families, 196608 phase rows and 128 physical banks are fixed; aggregate coverage rejects missing or duplicate context/prefix rows.
Shared float64-versus-float32 discrepancies and their expected-progress error bounds are saved; numerical tolerances are compatibility checks rather than scientific significance gates.
First-choice input is required byte-identical across both prefixes and modes within each context.
schema_checks: Inspected actual completed independent-validation JSON key structure only; models[condition][endpoint].paired.summary_sha256 and endpoint_summary_sha256 routes agree.
Frozen preflight raw physical schema includes pos, hd, mdir, vf, vs, vr, goal and t; first_update_physics and paired state/logit/probability fields match the new reader.
interpretation: Phase-averaged policy is an arithmetic counterfactual, not an actual state-erasure intervention.
This static readout measures actor access/use over a counterbalanced full circle; it does not itself measure recurrent attraction.
Effects near shared-case numerical discrepancy bounds must retain that precision context; no p-value or outcome-selection gate is introduced.
